description: Scholarly search over OpenAlex (250M+ works): works with title, authors + ORCID + institutions, year, venue, DOI, citation count, open-access status + OA URL and reconstructed abstract; or authors (works, citations, h-index, institution, topics) or institutions (country, ROR, works, citations). Year range, open-access filter, sort by relevance/citations/date. Falls back to Crossref for works if OpenAlex is unavailable. Returns JSON with: query, type, source, totalResults, count, results. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/openalex-search
